title: The Ice Spirit Cold Fountain
summary: The Alchemist Association gives Xiao Yan an alchemist robe, but no trading record in the Jia Ma Empire lists an Ice Spirit Cold Fountain. Ao Tuo reluctantly takes him to Gu Te, a reclusive alchemist who deals in shady things, past Bewitching Devil Grass and a reinforced steel door. Gu Te refuses at first and tries to throw him out, so Xiao Yan shows his only bottle of Amethyst Lion Birth Essence and pretends to walk away. At last Gu Te gives in and trades him the Ice Spirit Cold Fountain. At the Flying Transportation Company, Fu Lanke gives him a Rank Three Monster Core and invites him to the Alchemist Conference in the capital in six months. As an alchemist he rides for free, and the men of a three-tier alchemist, who were bullying a man in the queue, mark him.
